title: Just okay
text: Don't buy these, because it's a gamble on whether you get a good piece or get a defective one. Defects: QC on these is really bad. Left side's sound has suddenly gone significantly quieter than the right side. It has been barely 2 months, and the product has run into this issue. I had the same issue the first time I turned it on, but it fixed itself after resetting, but I can't seem to be able to reset it again, and it's annoying me. Problems: Why are the controls so unintuitive? When you wear these neckbands, the volume up button is at the bottom and volume down is at the top, what a wonderful design. Also, because there is the extra weight of the controls on the right side, compared to the left side, any kind of movement of the head rotates the earphones inside your ear, which makes it really unpleasant to have on. I would have given it an even lower rating, but other neckbands on the market are even worse, and there's nothing I can do about that. And don't even get me started on the "voice" of the neckband. It's so annoying, done just to "stand out". Everytime you turn it on, it goes "Power on, you've plugged into Nirvana. You've connected to boat Rockerzz." It says that second line twice if you've connected it to two devices. Also, the "mAxImUm/miNiMuM vOlUmE" voiceline is so over dramatic, like bro shut up. Also when shutting it down, it goes "Adios amigo, powering off..." So annoying, so much annoying. There is 0 simplicity and subtlety in this product. Also there's no aptX of any kind, and the even AAC is hard to maintain on certain phones, as it will keep resetting back to SBC, so false advertising at its finest. And sound quality? Lmao that's non existent... There's no bass... None at all... I have to max the bass slider in the Equalizer + turn bass boost to the max to get any semblance of listenable music. I bought this neckband just to have something to listen music on when I'm trying to focus and keep my phone as far as possible, but it's such a finicky and irritating product. I regret my decision of buying these everytime I pick these up. Would not recommend at all.

text: Thanks to Flipkart for super fast delivery. The order was delivered to me in 13-14 hours which is very good! Now coming to the earbuds, The package/box has the following contents on unboxing :- 1. The earpods which is placed inside the case 2. Two pairs of extra ear tips to adjust according to your size and get the perfect fit 3. A USB-C charging cable 4. A boat sticker  5. Few paperwork like warranty card, FAQ, User Manual and others The case looks good and the earbuds are very light, comfortable and fits perfectly in the ears. I have used it continuously for 4-5 hrs at one go it doesn't cause any discomfort or pain to your ears. The earbuds are held in the case via magnets which are decent and strong. The case colour is too glossy and is prone to scratches and fingerprints (would have preferred it to be a bit less glossy as it'll really look scratched in a few days of normal use). The hinge is good no wobbles however it could have been a better better in quality howebe considering the price it's good. The sound if the earbuds is pretty good. Yes it won't beat your wired bassy earphones however it's very good indeed. Sound levels are good. It gives sound like a rupees 500-600 wired earphones. I don't think the sound could have been better at this budget. The mic is okay and acceptable. You won't face any issues while taking calls or attending meetings when you are indoors however outdoors it'll struggle (this is a problem of almost every earbud and is a limitation by design since the earbuds have mic placed far from your mouth unlike neckbands or other earphones where the mic is directly in front of you) There is no disconnection issue, the charging time of the earbuds from the case is around 30-35 mins and it gave me a backup of 4-5 hours at 50-60% sound levels. Overall I'll rate it 4.3* not a perfect 5 as I think the build quality, battery of the case and mic could have been a bit better. If I observe anything else will update the review. Certainly a good and one of the best buy in the price range from a trusted brand like boat with 1 year warranty!

Sound quality (decent for the price). Cons: Built quality, Design. Looks and feels cheap.

text: Reviewing after using for 1 month. Sound quality: Average sound quality. Bass boosted but sound quality degrades in lower frequencies. Loudness: Pretty loud. 25% volume is loud enough for indoors listening. Hardly used over 50% volume. Noise isolation: Decent. Fit: Excellent. Battery: Hats off. Charge it, forget it. Connectivity: Excellent. Signal drops rarely even after 2 walls. Mic: No complaints. Built quality: Below average. Pretty sure the charging port is going to break first. Cables are sturdy though. Design: Dumb design. When the buds are plugged in, the upper button decreases volume and the lower button increases volume. The designers were probably drunk. Magnets: Not very strong. No auto off with magnets. One more thing: The dual connect is a life saver for me. It connects to my laptop and phone simultaneously. If the phone receives a call, it'll automatically pause the laptop media and switch to mobile. Really underrated feature. So conclusion: Pros: Battery life, Connectivity, Dual connect. Sound quality (decent for the price). Cons: Built quality, Design. Looks and feels cheap.

title: Perfect product!
text: The Mivi Fort S60 is a total value for money product.  - The packaging was super nice as expected from Mivi. The soundbar is quite good looking in this black colour.  - Has good connectivity ports at the back. Supports Bluetooth 5.0 which is very convenient and makes it a multipurpose device. The bluetooth connectivity is also quite strong. - Comes with a remote, a power adapter and an aux cable in the box. - It's not very heavy and it is overall built really well. No complaints overall.  - The audio is very punchy and it thumps really well when kept on a desk or you can also mount it on the wall. - It has 2 sub woofers and 2 tweeters, which produce really good audio with punchy bass that makes you move.  - It has 3 EQ modes for music, movies and news. But it always starts up in the music mode for some reason. As it is primarily supposed to be used with a TV, the default mode should be movie mode. - I usually use it around 50% volume, which is enough for my room. But the best balanced audio output will be from the aux input. The bluetooth one is more bass heavy.

text: The Mivi Fort S60 is a total value for money product.  - The packaging was super nice as expected from Mivi. The soundbar is quite good looking in this black colour.  - Has good connectivity ports at the back. Supports Bluetooth 5.0 which is very convenient and makes it a multipurpose device. The bluetooth connectivity is also quite strong. - Comes with a remote, a power adapter and an aux cable in the box. - It's not very heavy and it is overall built really well. No complaints overall.  - The audio is very punchy and it thumps really well when kept on a desk or you can also mount it on the wall. - It has 2 sub woofers and 2 tweeters, which produce really good audio with punchy bass that makes you move.  - It has 3 EQ modes for music, movies and news. But it always starts up in the music mode for some reason. As it is primarily supposed to be used with a TV, the default mode should be movie mode. - I usually use it around 50% volume, which is enough for my room. But the best balanced audio output will be from the aux input. The bluetooth one is more bass heavy.
